test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 3 : 4. The ratio of their expenditure is 7 : 10. If A and B save ₹2,500 and ₹3,000, respectively, then what is the ratio of the income of B to the combined expenditure of A and B?
solution:
Given:

Ratio of income of A and B = 3 : 4

Ratio of expenditure of A and B = 7 : 10

Savings of A = 2500

Savings of B = 3000

Formula used:

Income – Savings = Expenditure

Calculation:

Let the income of A and B is 3x and 4x respectively.

Then, their expenditure is (3x – 2500) and (4x – 3000)

According to the question,

{(3x – 2500)/(4x – 3000)} = (7/10)

⇒ 10(3x – 2500) = 7(4x – 3000)

⇒ 30x – 25000 = 28x – 21000

⇒ 30x – 28x = 25000 – 21000

⇒ 2x = 4000

⇒ x = 2000

So,

Income of A = 3 × 2000

⇒ 6000

Income of B = 4 × 2000

⇒ 8000

Expenditure of A = 6000 - 2500

⇒ 3500

Expenditure of B = 8000 - 3000

⇒ 5000

Sum of expenditure = 3500 + 5000

⇒ 8500

Ratio = 8000 : 8500

⇒ 16 : 17

**∴ The ratio of the income of B to the combined expenditure of A and B is 16 : 17.**
